tweet.text:
METR has received no funding to date from Open Philanthropy (/Coefficient Giving). They also take no funding from the labs (beyond API credits) and don't accept donations from individuals whose source of wealth is from working at the labs.

Beth left OpenAI 4 years ago, so while I understand the theoretical concern there it seems quite distant?

I agree Paul seems like a clearer cause for having some pause, but he is on the non-profits safety board, which seems distinct from e.g. having a commercial interest.
